description: The third titanium stage tier: coarse titanium windows re-bound to the substage landmarks sapphire placed -- start is open_well when placed and the coarse start otherwise, end is close_well when placed and the coarse end otherwise. Renders as a layer beside titanium_first and titanium_final, so the fringe either side of the final band is the open_well/close_well extension. Bound to the sept3 v2 vintage only, which is the one derived from nextier_titanium_stage_index_v2, so it is gated to the 'titanium_beta' stage model and returns no rows for silver or titanium v1 -- pairing it with v1 coarse windows would overlay two different vintages.
sql:
SELECT * FROM (
SELECT
  CAST(s.stage_num AS TEXT) AS window_label,
  CAST(s.stage_start_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS start_ts,
  CAST(s.stage_end_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS end_ts,
  '#A855F7' AS color,
  CAST(0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS sample_count
FROM featurestore:nextier_titanium_substage_index_sept3_v2 s
WHERE COALESCE(NULLIF(CAST(:stage_model AS TEXT), ''), 'silver') = 'titanium_beta'
  AND s.well_name = :well_name
  AND s.stage_num IS NOT NULL
  AND s.stage_start_ts IS NOT NULL AND s.stage_end_ts IS NOT NULL
  AND CAST(s.stage_start_ts AS TIMESTAMP) <= CAST(:end_time AS TIMESTAMP)
  AND CAST(s.stage_end_ts AS TIMESTAMP) >= CAST(:start_time AS TIMESTAMP)
  AND CAST(s.stage_start_ts AS TIMESTAMP) <= CAST(s.stage_end_ts AS TIMESTAMP)
) q
ORDER BY start_ts, CAST(window_label AS DOUBLE PRECISION)
